NOVA quality system

We created our own quality system for our customers which don’t have the size or the expertise to have their own system. Our quality system relies on our years of experience of automotive at OEMs and Tier1, and is a complement to the IATF standards. It is simple and efficient, covering all the necessary relevant points for our customers, and generating reasonable cost of use. Depending on your need, we can cover the following topics:

    Project

    processes
